name: Shoal
summary: Aquarium sign-in: a school of fish gathers by your field, hides for the password and swims into a heart
about: A full sign-in page for a Karachi aquarium, with a frosted member pass floating in a big tank: a canvas school of fifty neon fish, yellow tangs, clownfish by their anemone, swaying kelp, coral, light rays and rising bubbles. The school swims over and gathers beside the field you type in, turns away and hides in the kelp while you type a password, and scatters when a shark glides past on a wrong one. Signing in makes the fish swim into a heart around the form, and clicking the water drops food they rush to eat.
how: Watch the demo sign in by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email: the school gathers beside the field and bubbles rise with each key
Click the password: the fish swim off to hide; the eye button sends one clownfish to peek
Try a wrong password for the shark, or use Fill it in (zara@shoal.pk, clownfish5) for the heart
Click open water to feed the fish; the reset code is 460318
